zechariah.14.p1.b1.text: Behold, a day of the LORD is coming … For I will gather all the nations for battle against Jerusalem … Then the LORD will go out to fight against those nations, as He fights in the day of battle.

zechariah.14.p1.b2.text: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley …

zechariah.14.p1.b3.text: On that day … without day or night; but when evening comes, there will be light.

zechariah.14.p1.b4.text: And on that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it toward the Eastern Sea and the other half toward the Western Sea, in summer and winter alike.

zechariah.14.p1.b5.text: On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth … So Jerusalem will dwell securely.

zechariah.14.p2.b1.text: And this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes all the peoples who have warred against Jerusalem … On that day a great panic from the LORD will come upon them

zechariah.14.p2.b2.text: Then all the survivors from the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.

zechariah.14.p2.b3.text: And should any of the families of the earth not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, then the rain will not fall on them.

zechariah.14.p2.b4.text: On that day, HOLY TO THE LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses … Indeed, every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the LORD of Hosts
